messages:
carmen_rel: Heads-up: minor SDK patch 2.8 tonight 01:00 UTC. It tightens model/runtime handshake; could cause mismatches on mixed-instance pools. Thinking: prefer targeted pins by pool tag rather than broad region pin.

phil_sre: Agreed. Use pool tags (e.g., pool:legacy-gpu) so we don't block autoscaler for newer pools. Command: `rbctl runtime pin --pool-tag legacy-gpu --runtime-version v2.12 --ttl 48h --reason \"sdk2.8 compat hold\"`.

mina_eng: Deploybot supports pool-tag pins. Note: mixed pools where legacy and new nodes coexist will enforce the stricter pin and might reject new allocations. Add a quota-check step.

owen_qa: Ran quick canary: legacy-gpu pool saw a 2.2% quality delta with sdk2.8 defaults; new pools were fine. Recommendation: pin legacy-gpu pools for 48h while we monitor.

lee_prod: We'll update release notes to mention pool-tag pins and include opt-out instructions for Dedicated tenants. Also inform account managers.

phil_sre: Triggers for extending pin: quality drift >1.5% sustained 10m OR p95 latency +200ms for 10m OR any 5xx spike >0.5%. Manual unpin only.

carmen_rel: Owners for manual pin/unpin: @phil_sre oncall tonight, fallback @carmen_rel. Post a message when you pin so release notes can link it.

deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled canaries: legacy-gpu 01:10 UTC (15m), standard-gpu 01:30 UTC (15m). Telemetry hooks on.

owen_qa: Canary results: legacy-gpu drift peaked 2.1% for 12m. Proceeding with pin.

phil_sre: Executing: `rbctl runtime pin --pool-tag legacy-gpu --runtime-version v2.12 --ttl 48h --reason \"sdk2.8 compat hold\"` done. Posted incident link.

mina_eng: Logged follow-up ticket to backport handshake shim to runtime v2.12 and add an e2e for mixed pools.

carmen_rel: Thanks. We'll monitor for 48h and reassess; reopen thread if triggers fire. TL;DR: pool-tag pin used to limit blast radius, manual owners assigned.
